relevant_laws.quote: If a laned roadway is restricted to one direction, a person shall not stand or park a vehicle upon the left-hand side of such one-way roadway unless official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct one-way left-side standing and parking permission rule
relevant_laws.notes: Roadway direction, official device permission and activity remain original-source review questions.
